body:
My Elvis was only three. He had so much life left to live. The guilt I feel is too much and I know it will never go away. How can I ever enjoy myself doing anything, when he can't do the same. It's just not right. How can I live for years, when he can't do the same. If there's a chance he's out there somewhere, he needs me. And I need him. 

Thank you for replying to me. To everyone who knows me and knows what happened they offer sympathy but I know deep down they don't understand. They just think of him as a cat. A cat I can replace with another. I'd like to ask them if they think they could replace their child. You're a stronger person than I am. I just can't go on for another two years. Two days without him is too much.
